answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and evaluate an epoch polynomial, binding Semaphore/RLN proofs to one identity and rate limit. Reusing a slot produces distinct shares; Shamir interpolation exposes the private key, letting consensus verify the breach and slash collateral immediately. A mirror commitment makes equivocation auditable, while hollow proofs without valid stake carry no weight; at the epoch’s nadir, fresh commitments begin the next round.
